content.rendered:
To be eligible for Free and Reduced Lunch, you must fill out the Free and Reduced Application annually.  (One application per household.)

 

To complete the application online, click this link: Online Application



For a printable version, please click the appropriate link below, to access your application in English or Spanish.  


Fill out the application and return to your student’s school, or mail to: Attn: Kelli Gladheim, 16155 SW Sunset Blvd., Sherwood, OR 97140.  


Application 2017-2018 English

Application 2017-2018 Español


Permission to Share Form:


In order to be eligible for other benefits (such as reduced student fees, athletic fees, etc.), you MUST complete and submit the Permission to Share Form which can be found on the last page of the application.


NOTE: If you completed the Free and Reduced application online, the Permission to Share Information Form still needs to be completed and returned to your student’s school or mailed to: Attn: Kelli Gladheim, 16155 SW Sunset Blvd., Sherwood, OR 97140.  Click link below.


Permission to Share Information Form

Permiso para Compartir Información
